title: Random selection of cases
text: interest sample units, say clusters, proportional sizes, strata, use pc_pps_survey() function. Regardless geographical setup data structure, organize data frame primary units three columns: stratum, specifies strata primary units cluster, identifies primary units cluster_pop contains corresponding sizes primary unit (cluster). basic example demonstrates usage package function:
code: set.seed(1000) stratum = rep(c(1,2),c(30,50)) cluster <- c(1:30,1:50) cluster_pop <- sample(365:1309,80,replace=TRUE) sample_frame <- data.frame(stratum,cluster, cluster_pop)  sample <- pc_pps_survey(sample_frame,10) sample <- pc_pps_survey(sample_frame,nsize = c(10,7))

title: Random selection of cases
